lines: Ever spent 30 minutes choosing a movie
and then ended up watching nothing?
makes it harder to make a decision.
The same thing can happen in life.
You keep waiting for the perfect job
or the perfect time to start.
You don't always need the perfect choice.
Sometimes, you just need to make
a good choice and move forward.
that can change the way you see life.
Follow for more daily psychology about people and relationships.
